usage: General visual examples only. Artist-specific concert production requires a separate portrait-anchored nine-frame board and artist approval.
promptTemplate: Photorealistic-natural, landscape 16:9 professional live concert reference photograph. Use the scene direction below. Anonymous performer, real physical lighting, natural crowds and anatomy, documentary realism. No text, logos, watermark, collage, animation, illustration or 3D.

shots.scene: A sweeping elevated establishing photograph of the entire packed venue, stage and thousands of fans. The lead performer is a small figure on stage.
A low-angle full-body photograph of the lead artist stepping confidently onto the runway, microphone in hand, with the live band and audience visible.
An emotionally expressive close portrait of the lead singer performing into a microphone, face clearly visible, eyes engaged, natural skin texture, perspiration and authentic concert light.
A side-stage medium photograph of the singer moving with the beat, expressive singing and believable hands, cables, monitors and lighting rigs.
An eye-level audience photograph of joyful distinct fans singing the chorus together, hands lifted, candid human expressions. None of the fans resemble the lead singer.
A candid concert photograph of the backing musicians performing live, realistic instrument positions, drummer, bassist and keyboards suited to the music genre.
A photograph from behind the singer looking out across the huge cheering crowd, artist silhouette and outfit consistent, physical distance and venue scale believable.
A candid close audience photograph of an emotional fan singing along, genuine tears of joy and a friend embracing them, distant stage bokeh, no duplicated faces.

A triumphant wide concert photograph of the artist at the front of the stage, band behind, arms and microphone raised, entire audience responding under a spectacular but physically realistic lighting climax.
